Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0042 2026-03-04
MEETING NOTES — Station 01 and Station 02 Align
Handover Contacts
Date: 2026-03-04
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Attendees: PERSON-0013 for TEAM-0001; DEMO-STATION-01 desk
lead; DEMO-STATION-02 receiving coordinator; program calendar
clerk.
Purpose: Align the afternoon contact checkpoint for
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA paperwork crossing between the station
desks. ISSUE-0168, TASK-0447, and TASK-0448 locate the cabin
example.
Decisions
Use 15:40 as the shared handover checkpoint for this desk
connection. Each station keeps its own shift hours; the
checkpoint is a contact appointment within those arrangements.
The sending clerk brings the locating reference, next
administrative action, due date, and receiving role.
If the receiving desk cannot attend, the sending desk keeps
the contact responsibility and records a revised appointment
with the calendar clerk. Preserve the original checkpoint
entry so the incoming shift can see why the packet did not
Move at the expected time.
The receiving coordinator will compare the appointment sheet
against the incoming desk index. An omitted reference becomes
a question to the sending clerk while both desks remain
available. Delivery of a folder alone does not settle who will
arrange the next discussion.
Action items
- Owner: Program calendar clerk. Due: 2026-03-05. Add the
D. Worker 0013
Demo Worker 0013, Demo Team 01
